description: This file defines a PHP interface for a collection API endpoint in a Human Resource Management system, specifying methods for CRUD operations and their validation rules, along with associated exceptions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of resources, may throw exceptions related to normalization, implementation status, record presence, or access permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, may throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource, may throw exceptions related to normalization, implementation status, record presence, or access permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method, may throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list of resources, may throw exceptions related to normalization, implementation status, record presence, or access permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method, may throw NotImplementedException.
